c: Garlic places an aura of three rotating concentric circles around the player, dealing damage to enemies inside it.

acts similarly to Hitbox Delay for Garlic. Damage will be dealt instantly to an enemy if they have never been in the circle before, after which they cannot be hit by it again until the Garlic's Cooldown is over, even if they temporarily leave its area.

Enemies hit by Garlic will take more knockback and become more vulnerable to freeze. If the enemy is not immune to debuffs, each hit applies +0.3 knockback to the enemy until the maximum knockback they can take and -0.1 to freeze resistance until it reaches 0.

The debuffs applied by Garlic are its most useful ability late game. Strong enemies that take multiple hits to kill will be easier to keep at bay thanks to increased knockback, and some boss enemies can become vulnerable to freezing when kept in the circle for long enough.
Combined with a weapon to constantly knock enemies away, such as
, Garlic can enable the player to sit entirely still.

has natural synergy with Garlic; Garlic decreases the enemy's resistance to freezing, allowing Clock Lancet to freeze bosses, and even very powerful frozen enemies can easily be killed by keeping Garlic's Area-of-Effect over them.
If the player intends to stay idle, Garlic works well when paired with
, as enemies that die instantly to Garlic may drop experience just out of reach of the player.

Garlic's aura can kill most weak enemies instantly on low curse. Killing weak enemies quickly can lead to windfalls of experience and set up much earlier. Even in later waves, some swarms of enemies can still be instantly killed by it.
